drafted_from: workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input schema, steps) and tools/brand-kit/test/resolve-a-brand.test.mjs for the brand step's answer
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks for Harbour using my brand list list:brand-assets, my look look:harbour-look, the claims in list:verified-claims and the price in record:price:harbour, with a sales deck copy for Example Bakery Co and Sam's Cafe, written into the folder harbour-decks."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Have your brand rows ready in one list (one row with role selection naming the family in use, and a row per logo variant with its family, role, format, background and url), your look's tokens and font files, a list of verified claims with their sources, and the price in a record.

2. Say "Run workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks" with brand_list, look, faces, claims, price, buyers (each a record id), out (a folder) and copy_check (the command that checks public copy, with {out} where the folder goes); decisions is optional.

3. The AI works brand, look, decisions, claims, brand-book, decks, per-buyer, check-public-copy and approve in order. It stops and asks when no brand row has role selection, when a font file is missing, or when the copy check exits with anything but 0.

4. Look at every picture it shows (the brand book, the pitch deck, the sales deck, each buyer's copy) with each claim's source, and say whether you approve each exactly as shown. Nothing is sent to a buyer in this workflow.

worked_examples.title: The brand step picks the black wordmark for a light page and the white one for a dark page
worked_examples.ask: Make the Harbour brand book and decks and a sales deck copy for two buyers.
worked_examples.given: From tools/brand-kit/test/resolve-a-brand.test.mjs: the brand list has a selection row for family "original" and the variants wordmark svg black on transparent, wordmark svg white on transparent, mark svg black on white and mark svg white on black (all under https://assets.example.test/brand/), plus one png wordmark of another family ("autumn"). The step runs tool:resolve-a-brand with tone light, then tone dark.
